{{Quote|What about Nyriss? What will the Emperor do to her?''"<br />"''She will be purged by the Imperial Guard. Along with her entire staff of followers.|Scourge and Yarri|<ref name="The Old Republic: Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Yarri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood Sith]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Imperial Guard]] on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in direct service of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was the guard that pretended to defect in order to aid [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] in [[Mission to Dromund Kaas|killing the Emperor]], but really deceived them, leading the pair to become servants of the Sith Emperor. She was the leader of the [[Purge of the Dark Council]] in [[3950 BBY]]. She then dueled the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] when the latter, along with Revan and [[Meetra Surik]], attempted to [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|assassinate the Emperor]]; Scourge slashed her right hip, crushed her right hand with his foot, and [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] her.
